classification.difficultyReason: Total the retail prices, recognise the transport addition as an 1.08 multiplier, and round the resulting charge to cents.

content.prompt: A general store in a country town adds $8\%$ to the recommended retail price of all its stock due to transport costs. What will be the total charge if I buy a torch with a retail price of $\$9.50$, a tin of coffee with a retail price of $\$11.30$, and a hat with a retail price of $\$42.00$? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total retail price}&=9.50+11.30+42.00\\\text{Total retail price}&=\$62.80\\\text{Total charge}&=62.80\times(1+0.08)\\\text{Total charge}&=62.80\times1.08\\\text{Total charge}&=\$67.824\\\text{Total charge}&\approx\$67.82\end{align*}$$

The total charge is rounded to the nearest cent.
